result_comparison.method: Compare complete saved typed SQL-result row bags against earlier sealed scripted route results on the same database snapshot; no queries re-executed.

research_decision.finding: No observed read-price difference in tool choice in this fixed development batch: every trajectory recomputed directly.
research_decision.not_supported: An empirical improvement of a new cache-reuse algorithm over strong checks and on-demand recomputation is not demonstrated.
research_decision.still_unknown: Contract interpretation and SQL semantics require separate review. Cache descriptions were visible, so no cache read does not prove absence of description-induced influence.
research_decision.next_gate: Complete independent whole-contract reviews without exposing these later outcomes, freeze those labels, then review recorded programs and final text. Do not use outcome equality to create or revise primary labels.
research_decision.resource_decision: Do not expand repeated runs of these two tasks or start a new paid batch on this evidence alone.

reproducibility.test_scope: Bag multiplicity/type preservation, row order invariance, incomplete result stays unknown, invalid typed value rejection, and equality does not create semantic or final-answer labels.
